def execute_command(image) -> List[ImagePatch]:
    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)
    car_patches = image_patch.find("white car")
    
    # Sort cars by their horizontal center to determine if they are lined up in both directions
    car_patches.sort(key=lambda p: p.horizontal_center)
    
    # Check if the cars are lined up in both directions
    if len(car_patches) < 2:
        return car_patches
    
    # Determine the direction based on the first two cars
    if car_patches[1].horizontal_center > car_patches[0].horizontal_center:
        direction = "right"
    else:
        direction = "left"
    
    # Find all cars in the determined direction
    aligned_cars = [car for car in car_patches if car.horizontal_center > car_patches[0].horizontal_center == (direction == "right")]
    
    return aligned_cars
